providers.title: Deleting an edge
providers.scope: Deleting an edge merges the two faces of its darts or splits the face containing both, other faces unchanged.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Sphere maps and bridges
providers.scope: Every map has chi <= 2; in a sphere map an edge is a bridge iff its darts lie in one face, and deleting edges leaves sphere maps.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Trees and cotrees
providers.scope: The dual edges of the complement of a spanning tree of a sphere map form a spanning tree of the dual; for a spanning forest they form a connected spanning subgraph.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Face boundaries span the cycle space
providers.scope: In a sphere map the face boundaries span the cycle space over F2, with the single relation that all of them sum to zero.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Two sides of a cycle
providers.scope: A cycle of a sphere map splits the faces into two sides, an edge lying in the cycle iff its darts lie on different sides.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Euler count for a side
providers.scope: For a side of a cycle, (vertices strictly inside) - (edges inside) + (faces) = 1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Regions of a connected submap
providers.scope: The faces of a connected submap correspond to the classes of faces joined across edges outside it.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Dual triangulation
providers.scope: The dual of a simple cubic bipartite 3-connected sphere map is a face-coloured sphere triangulation.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Signed count
providers.scope: On the side A of a cycle of length h in a face-coloured triangle map, 3(B - W) = 2l - h.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Cutting along a separating triangle
providers.scope: Cutting a sphere triangulation along a separating triangle gives two smaller coloured sphere triangulations.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Two disjoint perfect matchings
providers.scope: A bipartite graph satisfying the degree-two Hall condition has two edge-disjoint perfect matchings.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Density inequality
providers.scope: Without separating triangles, e(U) - b(U) <= 2|U| - 4 for every vertex set U containing the roots.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Pairs of states exist (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A coloured sphere triangulation without separating triangles has a pair of states.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Disk identity (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A cycle traversed along the chosen darts of a state has delta-sum -3 counterclockwise and 3 clockwise.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Cancellation (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For a state s with a cycle in Q_s, the signed sum of i^J(r,s) over its partners r vanishes.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Face potentials
providers.scope: A sphere map carries antisymmetric dart weights with face sums 1 off a chosen face; cycles with that face on the right get positive weight.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A forest state (OpenAI)
providers.scope: If a pair of states exists, some pair (r, s) has Q_s a forest.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Two induced trees without separating triangles (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A coloured sphere triangulation without separating triangles splits into two induced trees with a prescribed split of one face.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Two induced trees (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Every coloured sphere triangulation splits into two induced trees with a prescribed split of one face.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Barnette's conjecture (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Every simple cubic bipartite 3-connected graph carrying a sphere map has a Hamiltonian cycle avoiding any prescribed edge.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
